Graded MINT 9 by CGC (6090947008). This is one of two examples of this piece recorded at its tier in CGC's census reporting, with one graded higher. Presented is an incredible, highly sought-after competition-awarded prize card. This prestigious, supremely desirable No. 2 Trainer Pikachu Trophy Card was awarded to a first-place competitor (across a variety of competition formats and age groups) at the 2013 Pokémon World Championships in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, the first World Championships held outside of the United States. These cards—the final "Half Art" iterations before the switch to Full Art Trophy Pikachu cards beginning in 2014—are incredibly scarce; while it is unknown exactly how many trophy cards were distributed at each stage of the World Championships, these items are very rarely encountered at public auction. The cardfront displays Pikachu—the mascot of Pokémon Yellow and, in many ways, the TCG in general—holding a silver, second-place trophy against a dazzling holo background. The art was created by Nakaoka. The card's text includes an invite to compete in the following year's World Championships. Due to their startlingly low mintage and inherent prestige, World Championships trophy cards are among the most infrequently offered and intensely sought-after cards in the Pokémon collecting community. Here's a sensational example awarded to one of the foremost competitors in the Pokémon TCG.
